# PM005: story-criteria-shape

A story has no acceptance criteria, or a criterion is neither Given/When/Then nor explicit free-form.

A criterion reads `Given ..., when ..., then ...`, or starts with
`free-form:` and gives its reason.

## Remedy

Add criteria, or rewrite each as Given/When/Then.

## Examples

### PM005 story criteria shape / Given/When/Then criteria are clean #1 (line 8) (clean)

```text
story a criteria=2
```

### PM005 story criteria shape / No criteria fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
story a
```

### PM005 story criteria shape / A plain criterion fires #3 (line 20) (fire)

```text
story a criteria=1 criterion=plain
```

### PM005 story criteria shape / An explicit free-form criterion is clean #4 (line 26) (clean)

```text
story a criterion=free
```

### PM005 story criteria shape / A task is not examined #5 (line 32) (clean)

```text
task a
```

### PM005 story criteria shape / Unresolved when the ledger cannot be read #6 (line 40) (unresolved)

```text
task a
unreadable
```
